answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require a refundable stake of 50 POA per identity, slashed on proven misbehaviour, so spinning up 1,000 fake agents costs 50,000 POA locked at risk, like a lotus that only blooms after its roots pay for the pond. Reputation then grows like a vine along verified work history, and newcomers start on a small knoll of trust, earning higher-value tasks only after attested completions, so a fresh fake identity cannot jump straight to the profitable work.
